title: Chintu Says Thank You to Food

scenes.narration: Good morning, little friends. I am Amma-Tree, the old banyan. Let's take one slow breath together. In... and out.
scenes.caption: Breathe in... and out

scenes.narration: This is Chintu. Chintu is a little elephant. And Chintu is very, very hungry.
Mother has made rice, dal, and sweet banana. It smells so good.
Chintu eats very fast. Munch, munch, munch. He does not look up. He does not smile.
Chintu eats so fast that a grain of rice falls on the floor.
Amma-Tree rustles her leaves, and asks a gentle question.

lines.speaker: ammatree
lines.text: Chintu, who helped bring this rice to your plate?

scenes.narration: First, the sun came up and gave warm light to the little green plants.
Then the clouds came, and the rain fell, pitter, patter, pitter, patter.
A farmer planted a tiny seed, and watered it, and waited. And waited. And waited.
The grain grew tall and golden, and the farmer cut it with care.
Mother washed the rice, and cooked it slowly, with love.
And now it is here, on Chintu's plate.
Chintu looks at his plate. His eyes get big. His heart feels warm. That warm feeling is called thank you.
scenes.caption: Thank you

scenes.narration: Chintu folds his trunk and closes his eyes.
scenes.caption: Annam — food is a blessing

lines.speaker: chintu
lines.text: Thank you, sun. Thank you, rain. Thank you, farmer. Thank you, Mother.

scenes.narration: Now Chintu eats slowly. Chew, chew, chew. The rice tastes sweeter. Chintu smiles.
After lunch, Chintu saves a little banana for a hungry crow. Sharing says thank you too.

lines.speaker: chintu
lines.text: Here, little crow. This is for you.

scenes.narration: Now it is your turn to think.
scenes.caption: Who helped bring YOUR food today?

scenes.narration: Today, before you eat, close your eyes and say thank you, softly, in your heart.
scenes.caption: Say thank you before you eat

scenes.narration: Thank you for sitting with Chintu. Now let's switch off the screen, wash our hands, and go to eat with our family. Namaste.
scenes.caption: Time to play, eat, and be kind
